crossRefs.note: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be…
Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it…

translations.web: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.
translations.bsb: because a will does not take effect until the one who made it has died; it cannot be executed while he is still alive.
translations.kjv: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
translations.asv: For a testament is of force where there hath been death: for it doth never avail while he that made it liveth.
